zh.summary: 先確認自己在哪個專案、使用哪個 Python 與套件，再啟動最小骨架；把安裝結果與功能驗收分開記錄。
objectives: 在獨立環境啟動起始骨架並記錄實際版本。
分辨工作目錄、直譯器、套件與執行入口。
在環境失敗時保留診斷，不冒稱已完成程式實作。

readingGuide.goal: 在獨立環境啟動起始骨架並記錄實際版本。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 解壓後工作坊根目錄、Python 3.11／3.12、終端機與瀏覽器。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: environment-notes.md 可讓同儕找到同一入口，並清楚知道骨架尚無哪些功能。

sections.heading: 開始前先找到正確的工作位置
paragraphs: 下載工作坊 ZIP 後解壓到自己的新目錄。README、requirements.txt、starter/、slices/ 與 reference/ 應在同一層；本篇命令以這個根目錄為起點。終端機目前目錄決定相對路徑如何解讀，編輯器開著 app.py 並不代表終端機也在那裡。
Python 執行程式，Streamlit 提供畫面與重跑機制，pytest 執行測試，Coding Agent 協助讀寫檔案及呼叫允許的命令。先確認每個角色，遇到錯誤才知道要查哪一層。

sections.heading: 像為一道料理準備獨立工作臺
paragraphs: 食譜是規格，食材清單是依賴套件，爐具是執行環境，完成的餐點才是功能結果。找到食材只證明可以開始，還要真的做出指定餐點並檢查。
虛擬環境把本專案的 Python 套件分開管理，方便依清單重建。它不會自動提供檔案或網路隔離，也不取代 M02 的 Sandbox 權限設定。不要把 .venv 當作可攜式備份或提交到 Git。

sections.heading: 沿著環境到行為逐層核對
paragraphs: 本包採 Python 3.11／3.12，固定 Streamlit 1.51.0 與 pytest 8.4.2。這是教學重現組合；requirements.txt 固定直接依賴，沒有宣稱鎖住全部間接依賴或所有作業系統。
每個階段都記下實際輸出。若 pip 安裝失敗，先保留退出結果與錯誤訊息；不要接著把未執行的測試寫成通過。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜先證明環境，再觀察功能
blocks.description: 這是核對順序，各步都有自己的證據；最後一項尚未執行就保留待驗。

items.title: 定位專案
items.body: 核對 README 與相對路徑。

items.title: 確認環境
items.body: 記錄 Python、套件版本及安裝結果。

items.title: 啟動骨架
items.body: 在瀏覽器看見起始畫面。

items.title: 驗收任務
items.body: 依規格操作；骨架尚無完整性功能。

sections.heading: 啟動起始骨架
paragraphs: 在解壓根目錄依序執行。POSIX shell 的啟用命令如下；Windows PowerShell 使用 .venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1，依既有系統政策操作，不為安裝而降低安全設定。
用 python -m 呼叫套件，讓安裝、測試與啟動跟著目前選定的 Python。若 shell 找不到 python3 或 venv 無法建立，先處理環境問題，不要求 Agent 改 app.py 掩蓋錯誤。

blocks.heading: 環境與啟動命令
paragraphs: 先讀根目錄 README，保留命令及真實結果；不要複製任何帳號或金鑰。
blocks.code:
python3 -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python --version
python -m streamlit version
python -m pytest --version
python -m streamlit run starter/app.py --server.address 127.0.0.1

sections.heading: 看到畫面後還要確認停止方式
paragraphs: 瀏覽器開啟終端機列出的本機網址。starter/app.py 應顯示起始骨架，並說明尚未實作完整性檢核或匯出。這就是此步預期結果；看不到下載按鈕並非環境故障。
回終端機按 Ctrl+C 停止本次服務。若埠號已被占用，先辨識既有程序與用途，不任意結束別人的工作；也不要為了讓網頁可開啟，就把綁定位址改為所有網卡。

sections.heading: 常見誤解與環境紀錄
paragraphs: 「同學能執行，所以我的環境一定相同」忽略了版本、平台與工作目錄。請記錄自己實際使用的環境，讓下一位能依證據排查。
「安裝好了就完成切片一」則少了表單與行為驗收。把環境、功能、學員理解分成獨立狀態，M07-03 才開始建立可用表單。

blocks.heading: 建議紀錄欄位
paragraphs: 另建本機 environment-notes.md，只填已觀察結果。
blocks.code:

作業系統與 Python：
Streamlit／pytest：
安裝命令與退出結果：
骨架啟動／停止：

未完成及下一步：

en.summary: Locate the project, selected Python and packages before starting the skeleton; record installation outcomes separately from feature acceptance.
objectives: Start the skeleton in a separate environment and record actual versions.
Distinguish working directory, interpreter, packages and execution entry point.
Preserve environment-failure diagnostics without claiming completed implementation.

readingGuide.goal: Start the skeleton in a separate environment and record actual versions.
readingGuide.startingPoint: The extracted workshop root, Python 3.11/3.12, a terminal and a browser.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: environment-notes.md lets a peer find the same entry point and identify features absent from the skeleton.

sections.heading: Locate the Right Working Directory
paragraphs: Extract the workshop ZIP into a new directory of your own. README, requirements.txt, starter/, slices/ and reference/ should be at the same level; commands in this lesson start there. Relative paths depend on the terminal’s current directory, even when an editor has app.py open elsewhere.

Python runs code, Streamlit supplies the interface and rerun mechanism, pytest runs tests, and a Coding Agent helps read/write files and call permitted commands. Distinguish these roles so errors can be investigated at the right layer.

sections.heading: Prepare a Separate Workbench for a Recipe
paragraphs: The recipe is the specification, the ingredients list is the package list, the cooking equipment is the runtime, and the meal is the functional result. Finding ingredients establishes preparation; you still have to cook and check the requested meal.

A virtual environment manages project Python packages separately so they can be recreated from a list. It does not automatically isolate files or networks or replace M02 sandbox permissions. Do not treat .venv as a portable backup or commit it to Git.

sections.heading: Check Environment Before Behavior
paragraphs: The package targets Python 3.11/3.12 with Streamlit 1.51.0 and pytest 8.4.2 pinned for teaching reproducibility. requirements.txt pins direct dependencies; it does not claim to lock every transitive dependency or support every operating system.
Record actual output at each stage. If pip installation fails, retain the exit outcome and error. Do not report subsequent unexecuted tests as passed.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Establish the Environment, Then Observe Features
blocks.description: Each check has its own evidence. Leave the final task unverified until it has actually run.

items.title: Confirm the environment
items.body: Record Python/package versions and installation outcomes.

items.title: Start the skeleton
items.body: Observe its starting screen in the browser.

items.title: Accept a task
items.body: Operate against the specification; the skeleton has no completeness feature yet.

sections.heading: Start the Project Skeleton
paragraphs: Run the commands in order from the extracted root. The activation command below is for POSIX shells. Windows PowerShell uses .venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1 under existing system policy; do not lower security settings for installation.

Use python -m so installation, tests and startup follow the selected Python. If python3 is unavailable or venv creation fails, resolve the environment first rather than asking the Agent to change app.py to hide it.

blocks.heading: Environment and Startup Commands
paragraphs: Read the root README first and preserve commands and real outcomes. Copy no credentials or keys.
blocks.code:
python3 -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python --version
python -m streamlit version
python -m pytest --version
python -m streamlit run starter/app.py --server.address 127.0.0.1

sections.heading: Confirm How to Stop After Seeing the Screen
paragraphs: Open the local URL printed by the terminal. starter/app.py should identify itself as a skeleton without completeness checks or export. That is the expected result here; an absent download button is not an environment failure.

Press Ctrl+C in the terminal to stop this service. If the port is occupied, identify the existing process and its purpose before acting. Preserve other people’s work and keep the local binding rather than exposing all interfaces just to make the page open.

sections.heading: Record the Environment and Its Limits
paragraphs: A classmate’s successful run does not establish identical versions, platforms or working directories. Record your own actual environment so the next person can investigate with evidence.

Installation does not complete slice one: the form and its behavior still need implementation and acceptance. Track environment, features and learner understanding separately; M07-03 begins the usable form.

blocks.heading: Suggested Record Fields
paragraphs: Create local environment-notes.md and fill only observed results. The unchanged Traditional Chinese template records working directory, OS/Python, Streamlit/pytest, installation command/exit, skeleton startup/shutdown, the absent form/check/export features and next steps.

exercise.environment: The extracted workshop root, Python 3.11/3.12, a terminal and a browser.
steps: Create and activate a separate environment, install requirements.txt and record actual versions.
Start starter/app.py, check its skeleton message in the browser, then stop the service.
Record successes, failures and unexecuted steps separately in environment-notes.md.
exercise.expected: environment-notes.md lets a peer find the same entry point and identify features absent from the skeleton.
exercise.check: Distinguish working directory from Python, and environment setup from feature acceptance.
exercise.cleanup: Stop only services you started for this exercise. Keep synthetic work, diffs and actual results; preserve other work and leave no real data.

zh.prompt: 虛擬環境最直接提供什麼？
rationales: 便於依專案管理及重建套件。

en.prompt: What does a virtual environment most directly provide?
options: A separate package environment for this project.
rationales: It helps manage and recreate project packages.
Business authorization is a different concern.

zh.prompt: starter 畫面指出尚無匯出，應如何記錄？
options: 骨架啟動成功，匯出尚未實作

en.prompt: The starter screen says export is absent. How should you record this?
options: The skeleton started successfully; export is not implemented.
Change the screen to claim success.
rationales: A skeleton is not the finished product.
Keep environment and feature status distinct.

zh.prompt: pip 失敗後最合適的下一步？
options: 保留錯誤與實際環境，先排除安裝問題

en.prompt: What should follow a failed pip installation?
options: Preserve the error and actual environment, then resolve installation.
rationales: There is no execution evidence for that claim.
Those rules are unrelated to installation errors.
